rules.name: Overview
rules.desc: The department requires the completion of nine courses (totaling not less than 45 units) of graduate work; seven courses of this work must be Department of History courses. Of the seven, one must be a seminar, and four must be graduate colloquia or graduate seminars. Directed reading may be counted for a maximum of 10 units. A candidate whose undergraduate training in history is deemed inadequate must complete nine courses of graduate work in the department.

children.name: History Courses
children.desc:
Students must take seven courses in the Department of History.

• These courses must have the HISTORY subject code.

children.name: Graduate Colloquia or Graduate Seminar Courses
children.desc:
Of the seven courses required:

• At least one history graduate seminar (400-level)

• At least four history graduate colloquia (300-level)

children.name: Other Coursework
children.desc:
Students should fulfill the remaining units with coursework that fits the following conditions:

• Only courses with a prefix of HISTORY and a number of at least 100

• Up to 10 units may be non-HISTORY
